notes.title: Game update - September 6, 2018
notes.notes:
Hello there，
Thank you for all your supports. In the newest version we add the voice system, French version and new character. Besides, we optimize the sprint speed and endurance cost.

[h1][b]Patch notes 1.0.7.0[/b][/h1]

[h1][b]Add

Voice system[/b][/h1]

[b]The new voice system allows players to communicate at close range[/b]

In order to change the lack of communication channels between players in previous versions, we added voice system. The players can communicate with his opponents on the plane or at close range through the voice system, there is no need to press any button, just open your mouth and talk.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1][b]French version[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32545769/8cff3195fafdedeef6aa1165c78a4020ea10af26.jpg[/img]

A game version in French has been added, players can switch languages in the Settings.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1][b]DLC -- new game character Harli([b]DLC is still in the process of review, please wait  for a while[/b])[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32545769/3b507915b96b0ea49b94f38efae26ed980c7a74a.png[/img]

The new character Harli is already available for purchase and use in the game. The DLC includes new character Harli and a companion melee weapon skin -- pink mace.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1][b]Optimization[/b][/h1]

[b]Optimized sprint speed and endurance costs[/b]

We initially envisioned that sprint is conceived to cope with crisis situations. But we found that as a game that requires constant movement, sprint takes a long time to recover is not appropriate. Therefore, in the new version, we reduce the movement speed of the sprint and in the meantime we improve the recovery speed and upper limit of the endurance value.

notes.title: Game update - August 6, 2018
notes.notes:
Hello there，

notes.title: Game Update - 2018 July 4th
notes.notes:
Thank you for all your supports. After 3 rounds testing ,air-drop is finally ready for showtime. Some numerical values and gameplay have been adjusted for better game experience.
[h1][b]Patch notes 1.0.5.0[/b][/h1]
[h1][b]Air-drop[/b][/h1]
Now you can find and use the transmitter setted on the wooden case in the field , the air-drop will land near the transmitter.
The items in the air-drop includes:
[list]
[*]Random weapons (M4A1 AWM and SCAR)
[*]Level 3 Kevlar
[*]Level 3 Helmet
[*]Bullets
[*]Medical Kit
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32545769/7830f795c21f385b5504aef4e92ed610b45fb486.png[/img]
[h1][b]Adjust[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Reduce the damage of UZI （18→14）
[*]Reduce the durability of Kevlar
[/list]
The high firing rate of UZI makes this weapon much more powerful than we thought.  With this adjust, we reduce the damage of each bullet of UZI（18→14） to lower its performance in long range but this weapon is still a monster in close range. In recent versions, the high level Kevlar can protect the player throngh the whole game without changing a new one. Thus we reduce the durability of Kevlar in order to increase the interaction between the player and the body armor.

[h1][b]Sweeper mode[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Shorten the wait time between every rounds in sweeper mode
[*]Reduce the drop rate of items in sweeper mode. 
[/list]
The waiting time between each round is too long in sweeper mode.We ensure that the players have enough time to pick up items and restore HP, under this permise we shorten the unnecessary waiting time. And in sweeper mode, the players need to shoot more accurately, so we reduce the drop rate of items from zombies.

notes.title: Game Update - 2018 June 6th
notes.notes:
We have a massive update ready for you. There are big and small fixes, in all areas of the game, and on over 15 categories. For example，Increased daily login rewards, which will greatly increase the speed of obtaining loot. Added sprint function, the player's movement speed will be greatly improved.	

[h1][b]Update 1.0.2.0 Changelog[/b]
[b]Move speed adjustment[/b]	[/h1]
In previous versions, the player's Move speed was affected by many factors such as posture, input device, and face orientation. This design is both complicated and unfavorable to the player's understanding. So we made adjustments. In this version, we not only balance the speed of moving forward, but also balance the speed of other actions such as retreat, lateral movement, squat movement, and so on. Now you will feel more stable and natural when you move.

[h1][b]Sprint function[/b]	[/h1]
We have received feedback from many players. One of the more representative topics is to increase the player's speed in the game. Because of the "motion sickness" problem in VR games, we did not give players the ability to move at high speed in previous versions. We admit that it prevents those physically adaptable players from having a better experience to some extent.For this reason, we have added "sprints" in this version. Now you can turn on this feature by pressing and holding the left hand trigger key when you think it is necessary. At the same time, we added a sprint-specific "energy slot." You will consume this energy slot when you are sprinting and will automatically respond when you are not sprinting.

[h1][b]Move speed of aiming[/b]	[/h1]
Many of our game players have live firing experience. Without exception, they all know that the speed of movement should be reduced when aiming. If you keep moving at a high speed while firing, the stability of the gun will deteriorate, and the impact of the recoil of the firearm will eventually make the accuracy of shooting much lower. When aiming in the VR game, the player's hands are suspended and there is no force point, and the VR device will be very sensitive to capture the player's hand trembling. The current VR head resolution is not high.When the player is moving fast, the objects they see will become unclear. Adding the two also greatly reduces the accuracy of shooting. For the above considerations, we have added a setting to the game. When you aim the gun, the speed will decrease by 70%. If you put down the gun at this time, we will think that you want to move instead of shooting, and it will return to the original speed.

[h1][b]Red dot sight[/b]	[/h1]
Updated the display of the red dot sight. At present, the player can aim more accurately. Red-point sights are classified into reflex sights and holographic sights and have been adjusted to the model of real firearms.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32545769/52f95c30437e1d199ae51b9aa0aebac2ed79bcfe.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Left/right hand mode[/b]	[/h1]
The player's comments mentioned the addition of a left-handed gun model, which we have added in this version. The way to turn it on is to select your dominant hand in the game settings.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32545769/a62eedcba52557a4caf2d6610be7bbc1f2ef17de.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Dual-hold mode[/b]	[/h1]
In previous versions, in order to simplify the player's operating density, we did not support the player's dual-handed gun behavior, which made many players who accustomed to authentic operation feel unpleasant. Since there are really many people who raised this issue, we decided to add this content to this version. Now that you can move the non-armed hand closer to the barrel of the weapon, it will automatically absorb, and the stability of the weapon will increase significantly. If you press the trigger button of a non-armed gunner you will grab the barrel and you can aim more accurately with both hands.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32545769/cd76fbe1bcde9181f35c4b98080b409aaed4416e.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Modify the way zombies appear[/b]	[/h1]
In this version, wild zombies don't appear out of thin air, and they exist in the game as bodies before attacking players. You can choose to bypass them or face them bravely.

[h1][b]Floor material sound[/b]	[/h1]
In order to enhance immersion, we have given different footstep sounds for different floor materials, and at the same time we have strengthened the influence coefficient of distance on the sound. In addition, we have also fixed a BUG, its existence makes the previous version of the distance impact coefficient almost ineffective, resulting in many players feel confused when they make a judgment.

[h1][b]New background music[/b]	[/h1]
We added 2 new background music, and each time you open the game, you hear them randomly.

[h1][b]Transport cabin[/b]	[/h1]
The color of the parachute indicator in the nacelle is too dazzling. At present, the tail signal is added as an alternative.And now you can see the players in the cabin.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32545769/19407978325564eca0b3b1089a2af2c6933f4daa.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Trophy[/b]	[/h1]
In this version, we have added apparel accessories that you can configure more personally. In addition, we added cold weapon mace. To be honest, the mace is so cool, and it hurts a lot. Just tap the mace you can kill a zombie.All these items can be obtained by opening trophies.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32545769/91969ae7af76b293ef23a04fd51857abf6e07e0b.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32545769/dd24d9025321be5f176251b1b66ff923aa778287.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32545769/d16a1209961262e30bfede3fe2dfb11e6793500f.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32545769/0149cbaa3680a73bd832eefadf62876ebfb9cfc0.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32545769/29932e9e81d6fdb8d5ddc30bd48518b16870f2d0.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32545769/1494675400d45cd98c60c14027a2865261d7c27a.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32545769/5a7d70bb6077ff424b3f83bbdadd2c40db235c68.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32545769/fe84a024d75ddce18f0454929e8c64361049e752.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32545769/9bb8f22bb557d52eba164f7f4855e27f55b2ab57.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32545769/2181b9be9464106c23fb26e5ebd8cceb02c36d70.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32545769/f05efe84cf8dd85347f86a07dcd346bdadbc3b6c.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32545769/efbd7e133ff45a41f5b8fc51c9eb1de4567966d5.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32545769/7d9bce17e2c4eeedfb94918d508e55d7e1e0d970.png[/img]

[h1][b]Gold coin promotion[/b]	[/h1]
Because of the increase in out-of-box rewards, we have also increased the number of gold coins in the game. First, you will get 100 gold coins each day, and then you will get 15 gold coins by killing one player character in multiplayer mode.

[h1][b]Adjust key operations[/b]	[/h1]
HTC and Oculus have different numbers of keys, so it is not conducive to compatibility development. In this version, we have unified the number of buttons and operating methods, and added sprint keys. For details, see the description of the keys in the game.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32545769/0a18cf948922e872f968bb6860d26f584d52e195.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32545769/eb52fed84dd56cb28ecf59199c84e3c784b3722a.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Camera[/b]	[/h1]
As the player moves in the real world, the characters in the game go through obstacles, such as walls. At this point the player can still shoot, which makes the game unfair. So we made a limit. If the player tries to pass through the object, the camera retreats.

[h1][b]Performance optimization[/b]	[/h1]
Adjusting the game architecture and object distance vision display, thereby improving rendering efficiency of 8%.

[h1][b]Modify the data synchronization method[/b]	[/h1]
In previous versions, the game had a large probability of starting to fail because of a data synchronization timeout. We have modified the synchronization mode to increase the reconnection efficiency.
